title: Character Studio character
description: character.json inside a .charstudio package, format 0.1. Units are points with the y-axis down, angles are degrees (clockwise on screen), and colors are sRGB hex with alpha. Readers should ignore keys they do not know.

formatVersion.description: Semantic version of the format. Readers refuse a newer major version (in 0.x, a newer minor version).

bones.description: The bone tree, parents before children. Format 0.1 files written by the app contain only the root bone.

slots.description: Places on bones that show one attachment at a time.

drawOrder.description: Slot ids from back to front. Slots missing from this list draw in front, in slot order.

skins.description: Skin name to slot id to attachment name to attachment. The app writes and reads the "default" skin.

poses.description: Saved test poses: pose name to bone id to a transform relative to the rest pose. Empty in 0.1.

animations.description: Reserved for the animation system. Empty in 0.1.

references.description: Editor-only reference images, bottom to top. Not part of the character: animation tools should ignore them.

parent.description: Parent bone id, or null for the root.

x.description: Rest position relative to the parent bone.

rotation.description: Rest rotation relative to the parent bone, in degrees.

attachment.description: The attachment shown by default, or absent for an empty slot.

pivot.description: The part's own pivot, independent of the bone origin.

fill.description: Solid fill, closed paths only (non-zero winding). Absent means no fill.

stroke.description: Uniform-width outline with round caps and joins. Absent means no outline.

points.description: Cubic Bézier anchors. Segment i runs from point i (p + out) to point i+1 (p + in); closed paths also join the last point to the first.

in.description: Incoming handle, as an offset from p. Defaults to [0, 0].

out.description: Outgoing handle, as an offset from p. Defaults to [0, 0].

smooth.description: Editor hint: false for a corner point. Defaults to true.

symmetric.description: Editor hint: true when the handles are kept equally long and opposite. Defaults to false; ignored on corner points.

weights.description: [bone id, weight] pairs for blended binding. Rigid parts omit this and follow their slot's bone.

file.description: Image file path inside the package, under references/.

width.description: Natural image size in points, before scale.
